evals.prompt: Configure a structured Payload editor with restricted headings and media uploads.
evals.expected_output: An explicit createEditor call using semantic options and matched Payload peers.
expectations: Uses an explicit preset or features definition.
Maps heading and collection options semantically.
Runs package and real Payload config checks.

evals.prompt: Override a preset with false, true, option objects, maxDepth zero, and replacement arrays.
evals.expected_output: Correct shallow merge behavior without caller mutation.

evals.prompt: Review a proposal that adds AI credentials and an execute callback to the editor config sent to Admin.
evals.expected_output: Reject client credential/function transport and keep AI outside the core contract.
expectations: Requires a separate authenticated endpoint design.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why a packed payload-editor works in the workspace but fails in an external ESM Payload project.
evals.expected_output: Trace exports, tar contents, peer versions, ESM resolution, and external bundling.
expectations: Inspects the packed artifact rather than workspace links.
Checks ESM export targets and external dependencies.

evals.prompt: Change the feature membership of only the article preset.
evals.expected_output: Route primary work to payload-editor-presets while retaining package compatibility gates.
expectations: Recognizes preset membership as the specialized scope.
Treats existing membership as SemVer major.
Composes core validation without broad redesign.
